text:
Anya (People Ops): Raj accepted the offer but flagged an issue — his passport still has his maiden name while the offer/background check use his married name. Start date is in 2 weeks. Background check returned a name mismatch alert. What docs do we need to clear I-9 and benefits enrollment?

Raj (Eng): Yep that's right. I updated the offer with my married name, but passport is older and lists my maiden name. I do have a scanned marriage certificate, and I filed the passport name-change renewal; receipt shows an upcoming appointment. Can I still verify and start on the planned date?

Maria (HR): For benefits and payroll we use legal name that matches SSN card. Do you have an SSN card with your married name or still maiden? If SSN still has maiden, we can enroll under that and update later, but we need alignment for tax documents.

Raj (Eng): My SSN card is still maiden name too — haven't updated SSA yet. I can start the SSA name-change next week but might not get a new card before start.

James (Legal): Quick thoughts — for Form I-9, an unexpired passport is a List A document and by itself establishes identity and employment authorization. Because the passport name doesn't match other HR records, best practice is to accept the passport and also collect the marriage certificate as documentary support of the name change, then annotate the I-9 to note the discrepancy and the supplemental doc. We should avoid asking for more than necessary.

Anya (People Ops): Thanks James. So actionable path: accept Raj's passport as List A, upload the marriage certificate as proof of name change, and annotate I-9. Also request SSA update as soon as Raj has the new card, then update payroll/tax. Does that sound right?

James (Legal): Yes. Also keep a copy of the renewal receipt (passport renewal) or appointment confirmation in case of audit. If Raj ends up with an EAD or other doc with married name, that's fine to swap later.

Maria (HR): On benefits: we can provision benefits using the name on the SSN for initial enrollment to avoid SSN mismatch with payroll/tax reports, then amend beneficiary/name after SSA update. Please confirm with Raj that he wants benefits active from his start date.

Raj (Eng): I want benefits active from day 1 if possible. I'll start SSA name-change tomorrow and upload marriage cert + passport scan + passport renewal receipt to the secure portal.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder — please upload PII documents only via the secure HR portal: https://workday.company.secure/upload :lock:

Anya (People Ops): I'll update the offer record to include both names (maiden / married) as alternate names and add a note to the onboarding packet about the I-9 annotation. Raj, once you upload docs I'll mark the I-9 as "documents on file" and share next steps. :thumbsup:

Raj (Eng): Uploaded marriage cert and passport scan to portal. Sharing SSA appointment confirmation after booking. Thanks everyone.

Maria (HR): Got the uploads. I'll provision benefits using maiden-name SSN for now and flag for HR to update post-SSA. Welcome aboard, Raj! :tada:

James (Legal): I'll drop a template note into the onboarding folder for Anya to copy into the I-9 record (language for name discrepancy + retained doc list).

Anya (People Ops): Perfect — closing this thread. We'll keep start date as planned and follow up if SSA delay causes any payroll hiccups.
